notes.title: Update v0.4.52 - Bots and Drops
notes.content:
[b]Additions:[/b]
- Terrain advantages. Mechs now have advantage or disadvantage on certain terrain blocks. This creates more strategy opportunities when playing, as having advantage will increase your stats considerably.
- Drop system. From time to time an item box will drop on the map. Get it to receive items like grenades, bots or even an increase on your max life.
- Added bots to the game. Frog, a turret like bot that you can activate on any part of the map and, Owl, a flying bot that follows you where you go. Bots can help you to deal with quacks and you can get them from powering up or drops.

[b]Fixes and changes:[/b]
- Changed impact grenade icon to better suit this item.
- Increased power up menu to show 4 options, instead of 3.
- Performance tweaks.
- Increased font size for power up menu.
- Rebalanced spawn system.
- Small fixes in ui behavior

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790400/c843ac3a9dc73e284018b990d1617edafe6bf128.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v0.4.43
notes.content:
[b]Changes and Additions:[/b]
- Added Steam rich presence for friends system. Now your profile shows if you are at the main menu or how much time surviving a run.
- Added control scheme hints on pause and settings menu.
- Added Brazilian Portuguese localization
- Changed loading screen animation.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed micro stutters happening on first playthrough due to shader caching.
- Fixed game not automatically pausing when opening steam overlay
